turns.query: Compute the Voronoi (Thiessen) tessellation of all 18 air-quality monitoring stations and clip each cell to the axis-aligned bounding box of all station coordinates. Use geodesic area (cast to geography) in km². How many sensitive areas of category 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION' have their polygon centroid inside the Voronoi cell of the Central station (station_id 16)? Return the count.

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Entity resolution (explicit id supplied by task / authoritative knowledge base)
station_id_central_explicit = 16
print(f"RESOLVED: Central = {station_id_central_explicit}")

# Fetch all 18 monitoring station coordinates, including Central station_id 16
station_coords_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
SELECT
  id AS station_id,
  name_en AS station_name,
  ST_X(coordinate::geometry) AS longitude_deg,
  ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) AS latitude_deg,
  ST_X(ST_Transform(coordinate::geometry, 2326)) AS x_hk1980_m,
  ST_Y(ST_Transform(coordinate::geometry, 2326)) AS y_hk1980_m,
  ST_SRID(coordinate::geometry) AS srid
FROM air_quality_station
ORDER BY id
"""), engine)

station_count = len(station_coords_df)
central_station_present = bool((station_coords_df["station_id"] == station_id_central_explicit).any())
print(f"station_coords_df row count: {station_count}")
print(f"Central station_id {station_id_central_explicit} present: {central_station_present}")
print("Station coordinate summary:", {
    "unique_srid": sorted(station_coords_df["srid"].dropna().unique().tolist()),
    "min_lon": round(float(station_coords_df["longitude_deg"].min()), 6),
    "max_lon": round(float(station_coords_df["longitude_deg"].max()), 6),
    "min_lat": round(float(station_coords_df["latitude_deg"].min()), 6),
    "max_lat": round(float(station_coords_df["latitude_deg"].max()), 6),
    "min_x_hk1980_m": round(float(station_coords_df["x_hk1980_m"].min()), 2),
    "max_x_hk1980_m": round(float(station_coords_df["x_hk1980_m"].max()), 2),
    "min_y_hk1980_m": round(float(station_coords_df["y_hk1980_m"].min()), 2),
    "max_y_hk1980_m": round(float(station_coords_df["y_hk1980_m"].max()), 2),
})

if station_count != 18 or not central_station_present:
    print("WARNING: expected 18 stations including Central station_id 16; re-checking station_id 16.")
    central_station_check_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
    SELECT
      id AS station_id,

      ST_X(coordinate::geometry) AS longitude_deg,
      ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) AS latitude_deg,
      ST_SRID(coordinate::geometry) AS srid
    FROM air_quality_station
    WHERE id = 16
    """), engine)
    print(f"central_station_check_df row count: {len(central_station_check_df)}")

# Count sensitive areas before fetching category-filtered records
educational_sensitive_area_category = "EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION"
sensitive_area_education_count_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS n_records,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE geometry IS NULL) AS n_null_geometry,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ST_IsValid(geometry)) AS n_invalid_geometry,
  MIN(ST_SRID(geometry)) AS min_srid,
  MAX(ST_SRID(geometry)) AS max_srid
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
"""), engine)
print("EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION sensitive_area count summary:", sensitive_area_education_count_df.iloc[0].to_dict())

# Fetch sensitive area polygons for EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION, including centroids and projected/geodesic area fields needed downstream
sensitive_area_education_polygons_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
SELECT
  id AS sensitive_area_id,
  name,
  category,
  geometry_type,
  area AS stored_area_m2,

  ST_AsEWKB(geometry) AS geom_4326_ewkb,

  ST_X(ST_Centroid(geometry)) AS centroid_longitude_deg,
  ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geometry)) AS centroid_latitude_deg,
  ST_X(ST_Centroid(ST_Transform(geometry, 2326))) AS centroid_x_hk1980_m,

FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'

ORDER BY id
"""), engine)

print(f"sensitive_area_education_polygons_df row count: {len(sensitive_area_education_polygons_df)}")
if len(sensitive_area_education_polygons_df) == 0:
    print("WARNING: empty EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION sensitive-area fetch; re-checking category counts.")
    sensitive_area_category_check_df = pd.read_sql(text("""
    SELECT category::text AS category, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM sensitive_area
    GROUP BY category
    ORDER BY category
    """), engine)
    print("sensitive_area category count rows:", len(sensitive_area_category_check_df))
else:
    print("EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION geometry summary:", {
        "geometry_type_counts": sensitive_area_education_polygons_df["geometry_type"].value_counts(dropna=False).to_dict(),
        "unique_srid": sorted(sensitive_area_education_polygons_df["srid"].dropna().unique().tolist()),
        "centroid_min_lon": round(float(sensitive_area_education_polygons_df["centroid_longitude_deg"].min()), 6),
        "centroid_max_lon": round(float(sensitive_area_education_polygons_df["centroid_longitude_deg"].max()), 6),

        "centroid_max_lat": round(float(sensitive_area_education_polygons_df["centroid_latitude_deg"].max()), 6),
        "geodesic_area_m2_sum": round(float(sensitive_area_education_polygons_df["geodesic_area_m2"].sum()), 2),
        "planar_hk1980_area_m2_sum": round(float(sensitive_area_education_polygons_df["planar_hk1980_area_m2"].sum()), 2),
    })

# Stage interpretation/domain notes for downstream spatial analysis
spatial_crs_units_notes_for_voronoi_school_count = {
    "source_crs": "EPSG:4326 WGS84; longitude/latitude coordinates are angular degrees.",
    "projected_crs_for_voronoi_and_bbox_clipping": "Use EPSG:2326 Hong Kong 1980 Grid coordinates; units are metres. Construct Voronoi cells and clip to the bounding box in this projected planar CRS.",
    "station_points": "Use station_coords_df x_hk1980_m/y_hk1980_m for Voronoi construction; Central is station_id 16.",
    "bbox_clipping": "Create the clipping bounding box in the same projected CRS as the Voronoi cells, preferably from all 18 projected station coordinates unless the analyst defines a broader study extent.",
    "centroid_containment": "Use EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION polygon centroids staged in projected metres for containment against the projected, bbox-clipped Central Voronoi cell.",
    "geodesic_area": "For ellipsoidal/geodesic area in square metres use WGS84 geography area (staged as geodesic_area_m2); planar EPSG:2326 area in m² is also staged for local planar comparisons.",
    "containment_predicate_note": "For counting centroids inside a cell, use a point-in-polygon predicate that treats boundary consistently; document whether boundary points are included."
}
print("Spatial interpretation notes staged:", spatial_crs_units_notes_for_voronoi_school_count)

import numpy as np
from shapely.geometry import Polygon, Point
from pyproj import Transformer, Geod

# Compute bbox-clipped Thiessen/Voronoi cells in projected HK1980 coordinates from staged station coordinates.
central_station_id_hk1980_voronoi_school_count = int(station_id_central_explicit)

station_points_hk1980_voronoi_school_count = station_coords_df[
    ["station_id", "x_hk1980_m", "y_hk1980_m"]
].dropna().copy()
station_points_hk1980_voronoi_school_count["station_id"] = station_points_hk1980_voronoi_school_count["station_id"].astype(int)

if central_station_id_hk1980_voronoi_school_count not in set(station_points_hk1980_voronoi_school_count["station_id"]):
    raise ValueError("Central station id 16 is not present in the staged station coordinates.")

def clip_halfplane_hk1980_voronoi_school_count(poly_coords, midpoint, normal, eps=1e-9):
    def side(p):
        return (p[0] - midpoint[0]) * normal[0] + (p[1] - midpoint[1]) * normal[1]
    if not poly_coords:
        return []
    out = []
    prev = poly_coords[-1]
    prev_s = side(prev)
    prev_in = prev_s >= -eps
    for curr in poly_coords:
        curr_s = side(curr)
        curr_in = curr_s >= -eps
        if curr_in != prev_in:
            denom = prev_s - curr_s
            if abs(denom) > eps:
                t = prev_s / denom
                out.append((prev[0] + t * (curr[0] - prev[0]), prev[1] + t * (curr[1] - prev[1])))
        if curr_in:
            out.append(curr)
        prev, prev_s, prev_in = curr, curr_s, curr_in
    return out

station_ids_hk1980_voronoi_school_count = station_points_hk1980_voronoi_school_count["station_id"].to_numpy(dtype=int)
coords_hk1980_voronoi_school_count = station_points_hk1980_voronoi_school_count[
    ["x_hk1980_m", "y_hk1980_m"]
].to_numpy(dtype=float)

minx_hk1980_voronoi_school_count, miny_hk1980_voronoi_school_count = coords_hk1980_voronoi_school_count.min(axis=0)
maxx_hk1980_voronoi_school_count, maxy_hk1980_voronoi_school_count = coords_hk1980_voronoi_school_count.max(axis=0)

station_bbox_hk1980_voronoi_school_count = (
    float(minx_hk1980_voronoi_school_count), float(miny_hk1980_voronoi_school_count),
    float(maxx_hk1980_voronoi_school_count), float(maxy_hk1980_voronoi_school_count)
)
bbox_coords_hk1980_voronoi_school_count = [
    (minx_hk1980_voronoi_school_count, miny_hk1980_voronoi_school_count),
    (maxx_hk1980_voronoi_school_count, miny_hk1980_voronoi_school_count),
    (maxx_hk1980_voronoi_school_count, maxy_hk1980_voronoi_school_count),
    (minx_hk1980_voronoi_school_count, maxy_hk1980_voronoi_school_count)
]

voronoi_cells_hk1980_clipped_to_station_bbox_for_school_count = {}
for sid, p in zip(station_ids_hk1980_voronoi_school_count, coords_hk1980_voronoi_school_count):
    cell_coords = bbox_coords_hk1980_voronoi_school_count[:]
    for other_sid, q in zip(station_ids_hk1980_voronoi_school_count, coords_hk1980_voronoi_school_count):
        if int(other_sid) == int(sid):
            continue
        midpoint = (p + q) / 2.0
        normal = p - q
        cell_coords = clip_halfplane_hk1980_voronoi_school_count(cell_coords, midpoint, normal)
        if len(cell_coords) < 3:
            break
    voronoi_cells_hk1980_clipped_to_station_bbox_for_school_count[int(sid)] = (
        Polygon(cell_coords).buffer(0) if len(cell_coords) >= 3 else Polygon()
    )

central_cell_hk1980_clipped_voronoi_for_school_count = voronoi_cells_hk1980_clipped_to_station_bbox_for_school_count[
    central_station_id_hk1980_voronoi_school_count
]

# Transform Central cell boundary to WGS84 and compute geodesic area.
transformer_hk1980_to_wgs84_for_school_count = Transformer.from_crs("EPSG:2326", "EPSG:4326", always_xy=True)
central_cell_lonlat_ring_for_school_count = [
    transformer_hk1980_to_wgs84_for_school_count.transform(x, y)
    for x, y in list(central_cell_hk1980_clipped_voronoi_for_school_count.exterior.coords)
]
central_cell_wgs84_clipped_voronoi_for_school_count = Polygon(central_cell_lonlat_ring_for_school_count).buffer(0)

geod_wgs84_for_school_count = Geod(ellps="WGS84")
central_cell_geodesic_area_m2_for_school_count, _ = geod_wgs84_for_school_count.geometry_area_perimeter(
    central_cell_wgs84_clipped_voronoi_for_school_count
)
central_cell_geodesic_area_km2_hk1980_voronoi_for_synthesis = float(abs(central_cell_geodesic_area_m2_for_school_count) / 1_000_000.0)

# Count staged EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION centroids contained in the Central clipped Voronoi cell.
education_centroid_points_hk1980_for_school_count = [
    Point(float(x), float(y))
    for x, y in zip(
        sensitive_area_education_polygons_df["centroid_x_hk1980_m"],
        sensitive_area_education_polygons_df["centroid_y_hk1980_m"]
    )
    if np.isfinite(float(x)) and np.isfinite(float(y))
]

central_cell_school_centroid_contained_mask_hk1980_voronoi_for_synthesis = [
    central_cell_hk1980_clipped_voronoi_for_school_count.contains(p)
    for p in education_centroid_points_hk1980_for_school_count
]
central_cell_schools_count_hk1980_voronoi_for_synthesis = int(
    sum(central_cell_school_centroid_contained_mask_hk1980_voronoi_for_synthesis)
)

print({
    "station_count_used": int(len(station_points_hk1980_voronoi_school_count)),
    "central_station_id_used": central_station_id_hk1980_voronoi_school_count,
    "central_cell_empty": bool(central_cell_hk1980_clipped_voronoi_for_school_count.is_empty),
    "central_cell_geodesic_area_km2": round(central_cell_geodesic_area_km2_hk1980_voronoi_for_synthesis, 6),
    "education_centroids_used": int(len(education_centroid_points_hk1980_for_school_count)),
    "central_cell_school_count_for_synthesis": central_cell_schools_count_hk1980_voronoi_for_synthesis
})

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

old_central_cell_schools = central_cell_schools if 'central_cell_schools' in globals() else None

# Fresh database-side recomputation in a projected Hong Kong CRS (EPSG:2326) for the Thiessen construction,
# clipped to the axis-aligned station-coordinate bounding box, with geodesic area computed after transforming to WGS84.
q_hk1980 = text("""
WITH stn AS (
  SELECT id, ST_Transform(coordinate::geometry, 2326) AS geom
  FROM air_quality_station
),
meta AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS station_count,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE id = 16) AS central_present
  FROM stn
),
bbox AS (
  SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(MIN(ST_X(geom)), MIN(ST_Y(geom)), MAX(ST_X(geom)), MAX(ST_Y(geom)), 2326) AS geom
  FROM stn
),
vor AS (
  SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom), 0.0, (SELECT geom FROM bbox)))).geom AS geom
  FROM stn
),
cells AS (
  SELECT s.id AS station_id, ST_Intersection(v.geom, b.geom) AS geom
  FROM vor v
  CROSS JOIN bbox b
  JOIN stn s ON ST_Covers(v.geom, s.geom)
),
central_cell AS (
  SELECT geom FROM cells WHERE station_id = 16
),
edu AS (
  SELECT id, ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(geometry), 2326) AS centroid
  FROM sensitive_area
  WHERE category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT station_count FROM meta) AS station_count,
  (SELECT central_present FROM meta) AS central_present,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu) AS education_total,
  (SELECT ST_Area(ST_Transform(geom, 4326)::geography) / 1000000.0 FROM central_cell) AS central_cell_area_km2,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu e, central_cell c WHERE ST_Contains(c.geom, e.centroid))::int AS school_count
""")
res_hk1980 = pd.read_sql(q_hk1980, engine)

# Independent sensitivity check using direct WGS84 station coordinates for the Voronoi construction.
q_wgs84 = text("""
WITH stn AS (
  SELECT id, coordinate::geometry AS geom
  FROM air_quality_station
),
bbox AS (
  SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(MIN(ST_X(geom)), MIN(ST_Y(geom)), MAX(ST_X(geom)), MAX(ST_Y(geom)), 4326) AS geom
  FROM stn
),
vor AS (
  SELECT (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom), 0.0, (SELECT geom FROM bbox)))).geom AS geom
  FROM stn
),
cells AS (
  SELECT s.id AS station_id, ST_Intersection(v.geom, b.geom) AS geom
  FROM vor v
  CROSS JOIN bbox b
  JOIN stn s ON ST_Covers(v.geom, s.geom)
),
central_cell AS (
  SELECT geom FROM cells WHERE station_id = 16
),
edu AS (
  SELECT id, ST_Centroid(geometry) AS centroid
  FROM sensitive_area
  WHERE category = 'EDUCATIONAL_INSTITUTION'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT ST_Area(geom::geography) / 1000000.0 FROM central_cell) AS central_cell_area_km2,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu e, central_cell c WHERE ST_Contains(c.geom, e.centroid))::int AS school_count
""")
res_wgs84 = pd.read_sql(q_wgs84, engine)

independent = int(res_hk1980.loc[0, 'school_count'])
central_cell_schools = independent

print(f"station_count={int(res_hk1980.loc[0,'station_count'])} | central_present={int(res_hk1980.loc[0,'central_present'])} | educational_institution_total={int(res_hk1980.loc[0,'education_total'])}")
print(f"central_cell_area_km2_hk1980_geodesic={float(res_hk1980.loc[0,'central_cell_area_km2']):.6f} | sensitivity_wgs84_area_km2={float(res_wgs84.loc[0,'central_cell_area_km2']):.6f} | sensitivity_wgs84_count={int(res_wgs84.loc[0,'school_count'])}")
print(f"VERIFY central_cell_schools: stored={old_central_cell_schools} | independent={independent} | final={central_cell_schools}")
print(f"central_cell_schools={central_cell_schools}")
